g.text: ONE PROVIDER'S OWN TRAFFIC · not a market measure

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #d7dbe2; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f3864
font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: Estimated time falls 3- to 10-fold, on Anthropic's own numbers

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: Anthropic's two time estimates side by side - how long a task would take a person alone, against how long

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: it takes with Claude - for each occupation group. The published file gives the first in hours and the second in minutes;

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: both are converted to minutes here.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Anthropic's published Economic Index data documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: The unit difference is the trap in this dataset: read raw, the two columns appear to show tasks taking longer with AI. Both are

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Anthropic's own model-generated estimates of a hypothetical unaided task, not measurements of anyone actually working, so the ratio

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is a property of the classifier as much as of the work. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and Max consumer plans plus Cowork;

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Anthropic's API traffic is a separate file and is not included here.
